scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @editor-video/core && npm run build -w @editor-video/timeline && npm run build -w @editor-video/domain && npm run build -w @editor-video/templates && npm run build -w @editor-video/integrations && npm run build -w @editor-video/db
scripts.setup: npm run build:packages && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,worker -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.dev:v3: concurrently -n web,render,agent -c cyan,yellow,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev -w @editor-video/render-worker" "npm run dev -w @editor-video/agent"
scripts.test:v3: npm test -w @editor-video/timeline && npm test -w @editor-video/domain && npm test -w @editor-video/integrations && npm test -w @editor-video/db && npm test -w @editor-video/agent
